question: The Y-shaped proteinaceous structure produced by the immune cells to defend our body against harmful bacteria and viruses are known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**immunoglobulin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Y-shaped proteinaceous structures produced by immune cells to defend our body against harmful bacteria and viruses are known as **immunoglobulins**.
 
• Immunoglobulins, also known as antibodies, are crucial components of the immune system.
 
• They identify and neutralize pathogens such as bacteria and viruses.
 
• There are different classes of immunoglobulins (**IgA, IgD, IgE, IgG, and IgM**), each playing a specific role in immune response.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amino acids** are the **building blocks of proteins** but are not involved in directly defending the body against pathogens.
 
• **Collagen** is a **structural protein** found in connective tissues.
 
• **Haemoglobin** is a protein in **red blood cells** responsible for oxygen transport.
 
• Immunoglobulins are produced by B cells (a type of white blood cell) in response to specific antigens.
 
• The immune response involves the recognition of foreign antigens and the production of antibodies to target and neutralize them.
